details: SimpleLogin is an open-source email alias service (built by Proton) that lets you hide your real email address from every website you sign up for. Instead of handing out your personal address, SimpleLogin generates a unique alias on the fly — a random address or one on your own custom domain — that forwards to your real inbox. When a site starts spamming you, just disable or delete that single alias; your real address was never exposed, and you can instantly see who leaked your data. It offers browser extensions and mobile apps to create aliases inline, supports PGP encryption, custom domains, and catch-all addresses, and can be self-hosted if you'd rather run the whole thing yourself.
